newsitem.title: USA: United Meridian says ups budget to $300 mln.
newsitem.headline: United Meridian says ups budget to $300 mln.

text.p: United Meridian Corp said Wednesday its board approved a $50 million increase in its 1997 operating capital budget to $300 million.
The company said stepped-up development activity in Equatorial Guinea, accelerated development of in Cote d'Ivoire, and property acquisitions prompted the budget increase.
Funding for this revised budget will come from cash on hand, operating cash flow, minor asset sales, and limited draws under its unused $275 million bank line.
United Meridian is a Houston-based energy company engaged in the exploration and acquisition of natural gas and crude oil properties in the United States and Canada.
